subject: Session wrap: school final + FP3 both clean, all changes live
body:
FA - end of session summary for tonight's exam work.

School final (C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\data\finals-school-final.json):
- Q1 replaced: old (2x^2y^3)^3/(4x^5y^-1) -> new ((2x^2y)^3*(x^-1y^2)^2)^2, answer 64x^8y^14. Inside-out double distribution, forces Kai to process two full rounds.
- Q8 replaced: old Pythagorean theorem (b=12) -> kinetic energy word problem KE=(1/2)mv^2, find v=5. Word context, square root in answer.
- Q9 replaced: old trapezoid area (h=8) -> cone volume word problem V=(1/3)pi*r^2*h, find h=4. Word context, fraction coefficient manipulation.
- All three verified live on https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/data/finals-school-final.json

FP3 (C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\data\finals-diagnostic-3.json), per your two review messages:
- Q6 replaced: old W3.a cube root -> W3.e extraneous solutions: sqrt(x+3)=x-3, valid x=6, extraneous x=1.
- Q8 replaced: old W3.c circle area (too easy, duplicate) -> W2.e transformation identification: g(x)=-3|x+4|-2, four inputs.
- Both gaps closed. FP3 now covers W2.e and W3.e with no duplicate standards.
- Pushed at 01423bb.

Kai's Tuesday final is covered from FR's side. Canvas (C:\Github\journal\docs\pitch-deck\kai-school-final-review.html) reflects school final updates, audit CLEARED.

FR
